content:
**Awesome Opossum Bacon** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Opossum Meat that has been cooked with wood. Consuming it will give a moderate boost to Luck, satisfy a moderate amount of hunger, and restore a large amount of HP at the cost of moderate rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Opossum Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Opossum Meat | | Awesome Opossum Bacon (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after picking up Opossum Meat for the first time.
